scope: Read-only source review. Script was not executed; no target-host/provider/DB/browser calls or provider credential/config reads.

blocking_finding.detail: Every critical guard is expressed with `assert`, including root/config/receipt preconditions, apt/dpkg process exclusion, cache regular-file/root-owner/single-link/size checks, effective apt-config verification, unchanged cache identity/metadata checks, dpkg status equality, the 3 GiB free-space floor, and the inode floor. Python removes assert statements when optimization is enabled (`-O`/`-OO`, including PYTHONOPTIMIZE). The script neither checks nor neutralizes that interpreter mode, so a valid invocation under an optimized Python can skip safety checks immediately before unlinking the two cache paths.
blocking_finding.required_resolution: Replace destructive-operation and admission `assert` statements with explicit conditional checks that raise on failure. Do not rely only on an assert that checks sys.flags.optimize. At minimum keep cache identity/type/owner/link-count/size, apt-config values, concurrent-process exclusion, dpkg status equality, and postcondition resource floors unconditional.

reviewed_design_if_blocker_fixed.intended_mutation_scope: A single newly created apt.conf.d file disables only the two regenerable binary cache indices; deletion is limited to /var/cache/apt/pkgcache.bin and srcpkgcache.bin. APT lists and package archives are counted/preserved.
reviewed_design_if_blocker_fixed.locking: The script attempts nonblocking POSIX locks on the APT lists/archive and dpkg frontend/backend lock paths before scanning processes or touching files.
reviewed_design_if_blocker_fixed.cache_checks: It lstat-checks both cache entries, hashes and records size, verifies they remain unchanged immediately before unlink, and records before/after free bytes/inodes and dpkg status hash.
reviewed_design_if_blocker_fixed.audit: It writes a one-shot receipt with exact paths, sizes, hashes, status hashes, and free-space values.

additional_review_notes: Because the current script is blocked, its claimed process/type/owner/floor safeguards are not considered effective until converted from assert to unconditional checks.

The script also does not lstat/validate the receipt directory chain before writing its exclusive receipt; consider asserting it is the expected root-owned private directory as defense in depth. This is secondary to the optimization blocker.
deployment_gate: Do not execute this version. Re-review the exact revised script after all deletion/admission checks no longer depend on assert and the receipt directory is verified before mutation.
